text: My husband and I truly haven’t stopped talking about Heather since our wedding a couple days ago! She is fantastic!! So incredibly talented, so professional, and she’s more than just a wedding vendor. After the wedding, Heather texted me so many nice photos and videos of our day that we’ll cherish forever! She fluffed my dress right before I walked down the aisle, I can’t thank her enough! It was like a great friend was there the whole day! Our guests talked about her the whole night and she was very engaging with our guests! 1000% recommend!

owner_reply.text:
Awww Brittany! This is sooo meaningful! I am so thankful I got to come and paint for you and your guest! Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. I’m beyond grateful I’ve been connected with you.
Soo glad you love your painting!!
